goals: Verify that the $once function is correctly added to scopes and can register event handlers.
Verify that event handlers registered with $once are invoked exactly once per event, even if broadcast multiple times.
activities: Register a one-time event handler for 'ngOnce.sound' on '$rootScope'.
Assert the event name received by the handler is 'ngOnce.sound'.
Assert the sound data received by the handler is 'boop'.
Register a one-time event handler for 'ngOnce.sound' on '$rootScope'.
Assert the event name received by the handler is 'ngOnce.sound'.
Assert the sound data received by the handler is 'boop'.
Assert that the child scope has a function property named '$once'.
Register a one-time event handler for 'ngOnce.sound' on the child scope.
Assert the event name received by the handler is 'ngOnce.sound'.
Assert the sound data received by the handler is 'boop'.
Register a one-time event handler for 'ngOnce.sound' and capture its deregistration function.
Assert that the captured deregistration function is a function.
